# Step 2.130 — Starting a new season

## Builder 1 (below the screen)

**What exists.** `leagues.start_season` (`packages/core/src/modules/leagues/commands/start-season.ts`): name, short name, dates, `carry` = `nothing` | `teams` | `teams-and-rosters`. Copies from the program's current season what T-378 lists; carried teams keep their lineage; the new season is `draft` (hidden, A-18) and not current. With no current season nothing is copied (`copiedFromSeasonId: null`). `leagues.archive_season` sets the season to `completed` (T-376), which visitors already see under the season picker. "Make this the current season" is the existing `leagues.set_current_season`; it still works on an archived season (S-99). No un-archive: the spec gives none (S-100). Database: `copy-season-setup.ts`, `find-current-season-id.ts`, `season-is-archived.ts`; no migration.

**Read-only (O-12, T-377).** `defineCommand` takes `refusedInArchivedSeason`; the framework refuses with `season-archived` after `allowed`. Covered: games — mark not started, reopen own result, reopen tracked game, assign/unassign scorekeeper, cancel, postpone, put back, give/clear game rules (always); record final score, forfeit, box score, tracker commands, end tracked game, open/renew/release/take over scoring (unless the game has a correction). Teams — all 11 team and roster commands. Scheduling — all 12 draft commands and publish. Leagues — update season, season rules, roster settings, create division. Not covered: `games.put_sheet_back` (a correction tool, left open on purpose), division update/remove/reorder/restore, season- or league-level `set_setting`/`clear_setting`, bin restores, imports, standings commands.

**What passed.** `packages/database/src/stores/new-season-commands.test.ts` (6: teams carried and rosters left, both carried, fresh, no current season, another league can neither start nor archive, refusals of result/own reopen/not started/team/roster/season edit, the correction with a reason then a new result) and `role-matrix.test.ts` (269 with the two new rows). `npm run typecheck` clean. The tests were written after the code, so they were not seen failing first (they failed first only on test data).

**Builder 2 must build** (in `apps/web/src/app/[league]/admin/season`, text in `packages/site/src/messages/en/`):

1. "Start a new season" in Season settings, where Teams' sentence "This league has no current season yet. Add one in Season settings first." points; that sentence on Teams links to it. Fields: name, short name, dates, and the one choice (start fresh / bring the teams / bring the teams and their rosters).
2. After it is made: "<name> is ready. Visitors cannot see it until you show it."
3. "Make this the current season" (`setCurrentSeason`) and "Archive" (`archiveSeason`, one question first), each naming the season version.
4. Words for every new refusal: `season-archived` on each command above, `season-slug-taken`, `program-not-found`. The tracker's two (`tracker.notStarted.refused.season-archived`, `tracker.reopen.refused.season-archived`) exist; the game-rules refusal list gained `season-archived` too (check its words). Activity log words for `leagues.start_season` and `leagues.archive_season`.
5. The stand-in world (`apps/web/src/server/stand-in-world-standings.ts`) answers `currentSeasonOf` and `copySeasonSetup` with `notYet`: give it real ones for the screens and browser test.
6. The public season picker shows both seasons; page-step rows and the pinned lists of rule 9; a browser test of the plan's done test.

**What I distrust.** "Unless the game has a correction" lets result entry pass for any game ever corrected, even one reopened before archiving. The read offers (`read_reopen_offer`, `read_own_result_offer`, not-started offer) do not yet say `season-archived`, so a page may offer a button the command then refuses. The copy writes `rules` without checking the document version.

## Builder 2 (the holes below the screen)

**What exists.** A game in an archived season takes a result, box score, forfeit or tracker work only while a correction is open on it: its newest correction reopened it and it is not decided again (`correctionOpenOn`, `gameInArchivedSeasonNotReopened`, T-381); a game corrected before archiving is refused, and once decided again it is read-only again. `games.reopen_tracked_game` is no longer refused for everyone there: a scorekeeper gets `season-archived` from its rule (`reopen-window.ts`), a corrector reopens it with a reason (the box score page's door for a tracked game). Now also refused with `season-archived`: division update, remove, reorder, restore; `set_setting` / `clear_setting` at a season (league and program stay open); restoring a team or game into an archived season; import start, apply, record scores, undo. Discarding an import that was never applied stays open. `games.put_sheet_back` is not refused for the season (T-380). Ports gained `seasonArchived` on the bin and imports stores. The offers say `season-archived`: `read_own_result_offer(s)`, `read_reopen_offer` (scorekeeper), `read_game_format` (`change.reason`, contract enum too), and `list_scoring_offers` leaves the season's games out unless a correction is open. Mark not started has no offer read: the tracker cannot open such a game (scoring is refused) and a game ever decided is never cleared (S-40). The stand-in world now has `createSeason`, `currentSeasonOf`, `copySeasonSetup` (`stand-in-world-new-season.ts`) and `seasonArchived` on its bin and imports stores.

**Changed from builder 1.** The copy no longer carries season-level settings: `only-writer.test.ts` (record 065) failed on it, since only the settings commands may write a setting; `SeasonSetupCopied` lost `settings`; T-378 says so. No declared setting is season-level today. Isolation: cases for `leagues.start_season` and `leagues.archive_season`; reviewed reasons for `copySeasonSetup`, `findCurrentSeasonId`, `seasonIsArchived` (the coverage test failed on all five). T-376 to T-378, T-380, T-381 sit under T3, T-379 under T6.

**Seen failing first (break one line, run, restore).** Builder 1's six: rosters `if (!copy.rosters)` flipped: tests 1 and 2 failed; `left_on` filter removed: test 2; `teams: true`: test 3; `program-not-found` swapped: test 4 (it guards the answer, the store's league filter is the isolation cases' job); framework check `&& false`: test 5; `length >= 0`: test 6. All yes. Mine: old correction rule, update-division check, season-setting check, restore-team check, undo-import check, a refusal added to put back, own-result offer (single and list), game-format offer, scoring offers, tracker reopen offer, stand-in roster filter: each failed its test, yes.

**What passed.** `archived-season-commands.test.ts` 7, `new-season-commands.test.ts` 6, `read-reopen-offer.test.ts`, `list-scoring-offers.test.ts`, `stand-in-world-new-season.test.ts` 2, core games, leagues, imports and command folders 948, role matrix, isolation 385, stand-in agrees, `tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs` 11, `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`. No migration. No new command or read, so no new role-matrix row.

**Builder 3 must build.** Builder 1's list stands, with words for these new refusals and offer codes too: `season-archived` on the division, setting, bin and import commands; the own-result offer code and the tracker reopen offer code `season-archived`; the game-rules reason `season-archived` in the format view. Item 5 is done.

**What I distrust.** `ownResultWindows` reads each decided game by hand once more to learn its season. Standings commands (adjustments, coin flips, award, overturn, rebuild) are still open in an archived season. The copy still writes `rules` without checking the document version.

## Builder 3 (the screens)

**What exists.** Season settings (`apps/web/src/features/season-settings`): "Start a new season" (`season-start-panels.tsx`, `run-start-season.ts`, anchor `#start-season`): name, short name, two optional dates and the one choice of teams, saying what is copied from the current season (game rules, statistics, divisions) and what is not; with no current season it says nothing is copied and sends `carry=nothing`. Made: the page opens on the new season at "Who can see this season" with "<name> is ready. Visitors cannot see it until you show it." beside step 2.182's "Show this season to visitors". "Current and archived" (`run-season-change.ts`, `#season-state`): "Make this the current season" and "Archive this season", each asked once with plain words (archive: read-only, only a correction with a reason, cannot be un-archived, S-100); an archived season shows no archive button. Teams' "no current season" sentence now carries the link "Start a new season" (`startSeasonAddress`). A league with no season shows the form under "This league has no current season yet. Start one below."

**Words.** `error.season-archived` (every area that falls back to `error.<code>`: teams, divisions, settings, bin, season), `error.leagues.start_season.*`, `admin.games.error.season-archived`, `admin.boxScore.error.season-archived` (and the put back through it), `admin.import.error.season-archived`, `admin.games.reopenWho.archived` (own-result and tracker reopen offers, `reopen-view.ts`), `tracker.format.archived` (format panel), activity words for start and archive.

**T-387 (standings in an archived season).** Adjustment, award, overturn carry a reason and pass; rebuild passes; coin flip passes only with its note, removing an adjustment or a flip only with its reason, else `season-archived` (`standings/archived-season.ts`). `StandingsTx['games']` gained `seasonArchived`.

**Seen failing first.** `standings/archived-season.test.ts` (the two refusals failed before the check), `reopen-view.test.ts` new case (failed with the old view).

**What passed.** `new-season-test` (16 checks), `harmful-text-test` (2190, with the new form's two boxes), `nothing-unfinished-test`, `npm run test:web` (272), vitest season-settings, teams-area, games-area, fixture-import, game-format, standings, leagues, activity messages, `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`. No new page, command or read.

**What is left.** The browser test does not yet: open an archived game's result entry, a scorekeeper's own reopen and mark not started, an admin's correction with a reason, nor a league with no current season led from Teams (the stand-in has none); the database tests cover those rules. Rosters carried vs left behind are not checked in the browser, only that teams came. The import screen's own "no current season" sentences do not link to the form.

**What I distrust.** The start form's refusal loses what was typed (a plain redirect). `mayStartSeason` uses the shown season's program, so a second program's admin may see a form the command refuses.

## Independent review

Attacks tried by reading and by a throwaway PGlite test (not committed); two checks broken by hand.

**High.**

1. **A second program's season is started in the default program.** `run-start-season.ts:37` never passes `programId`, so `leagues.start_season` uses the league's default program (`find-program-id.ts`) and copies that program's current season. Repro: league with a second program B with its own current season; `startSeason(owner, { slug, name, carry: 'teams' })` creates the season in the default program, not B (seen: `in_b: false`). For Faraj, opening Season settings on program B's season and starting one lands it in the other program with the other program's teams. The page checks the shown season's program (`season-settings-page.tsx:97`) and the command another. B's current season itself is not touched.
2. **Archiving a hidden season publishes it, and it cannot be hidden again.** `archive-season.ts:37` turns any status, `draft` included, into `completed`, which `list-public-seasons.ts` and `find-public-season.ts` show; `update_season` (the only hide) is then refused with `season-archived`. Repro: `newSeason` (draft), `archiveSeason` gives `{"status":"completed"}`. The panel offers Archive on a hidden season (`season-start-panels.tsx:46`) and its question says visitors "still find it", which is untrue for a hidden one. Refuse archiving a draft season, or keep it hidden.
3. **A scorekeeper slips a result through an admin's open correction.** `correctionOpenOn` (`games/archived-season.ts:32`) asks only whether the game is open, not who acts; `record_final_score` then allows anyone `mayScoreGame` allows. Repro: archived season, owner `reopenGame` with a reason, a league-scope scorekeeper `recordFinalScore` gives `ok: true`. The same door lets a scorekeeper do `set_box_score`, `record_forfeit`, the tracker's commands and a scoring session (same check, read, not run). O-12 says only someone allowed to correct games. The door also never closes on an abandoned correction (there is no abandon): it stays open until someone enters a result, and a correction left open before archiving stays open after it.

**Medium.**

4. Standings stay writable in an archived season: `add_adjustment`, `award_game`, `overturn_result`, `rebuild_standings` (T-387). Seen: `addAdjustment` with a reason gives `ok: true`. Defensible as "a correction with a reason", but it goes beyond the O-12 row ("a correction with a reason by someone allowed to correct games"): the lead should confirm T-387 against O-12, or narrow it to correctors.
5. "Make this the current season" on a hidden season empties the public pages (`find-public-season.ts` finds no current shown season). The question (`admin-settings.ts:164`) says "the league's pages open on it from now on", which is untrue while it is hidden. Make it say so, or refuse.
6. Removing `create_team`'s archived check by hand: no test fails (archived-season, new-season and teams tests, 84 passed). Of the 11 team commands, few are tested in an archived season.
7. Teams, Schedule and the rest of an archived current season still show their edit buttons; only the refusal words say read-only. Only the game offers say `season-archived`.

**Low.**

8. Browser test gaps, confirmed: no result entry in an archived game, no scorekeeper's own reopen or mark not started, no admin's correction with a reason, no "start fresh", no league with no current season reached from Teams, no roster check. The rosters carried versus left behind are not told apart: both seasons only check `main a[href*="/admin/teams/"]` count > 0 (`new-season-test.mjs:151`), which does not tell the two carry choices apart. Role cases on the page are not checked.
9. Copying holds: lineage is kept (`lineage_id` carried); teams in the bin or that left, players who left, people in the bin and people deleted for good are left out; only jersey, role and order are copied, nothing private. Double tap holds (the second gets `season-slug-taken`); an end date before the start date gives `invalid-input`. Two seasons may share a name with different short names. The copy is from the program's current season, not the newest one.

**Holds.** Another league can neither start nor archive (tested). Permission is `season.settings` at the program, on the command and on the page. Purging people is not blocked. There is no un-archive, and both the question and the archived panel say so. `put_sheet_back` stays open in an archived season, being a correction (T-380). Breaking `record_final_score`'s check by hand was caught by `archived-season-commands.test.ts` (T-381 case) and `new-season-commands.test.ts` (read-only case); both restored with `git checkout`.

## Fix round A (below the screens)

**Fixed, each test seen failing first.** (1) A new season lands in the program the admin is working in: the start form sends the shown season's program, `run-start-season.ts` passes it, and the form says which season of that program it copies (`run-start-season.test.ts`; two-program case in `new-season-commands.test.ts`: copies that program's current season and teams, the other program's seasons unchanged). T-387 confirmed by the lead (one sentence in its pending file). Spec: P3 line 94, P2 line 97.
